title: Ster organization policy
description: Restrictions an organization places on the application. Every item is optional; an absent item means no restriction. Policy can only restrict.

allow.description: Agent ids that may be installed and started. Absent: all agents.

customAllowed.description: Whether users may add and start agents defined by a start command.

url.description: Registry index in the public registry format. Required when mode is custom.

requireChecksum.description: Refuse to install agents for which the registry publishes no checksum.

allowInstallScripts.description: Whether users may allow package install scripts for an agent.

modes.description: Selectable permission modes. Absent: all modes.

default.description: Mode preselected for new sessions. Must be one of modes when modes is present.
